hooks.command: file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if [[ "$file_path" == *.go ]]; then gofmt -w "$file_path" && go vet "$(dirname "$file_path")/..." 2>/dev/null; fi; true

file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if [[ "$file_path" =~ \.(ts|html|scss)$ ]]; then cd src/frontend && npx prettier --write "$file_path" 2>/dev/null && npx eslint --fix "$file_path" 2>/dev/null; fi; true
